_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Bo ta joga Solitariu Klondike. Bo meta e move tudu kartus pa pilha di fundasao.

Regula di Jogu:
- Pilha di fundasao (F1-F4): Konstrui pa riba de As pa Rei na kolor
- Pilha di tableau (T1-T7): Konstrui pa baxu alternando kolor (vermelhu sobri pretu, pretu sobri vermelhu)
- Estoku: Saí kartus pa pilha di lixo
- Lixo (W): Kartu di riba disponivel pa joga

Komandus:
- 'draw' - Saí kartus de estoku pa lixo
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Move kartus entre pilhas
  Exemplu: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. Konta tambe podi saí 'all', ku ta tenta move tudu kartus di riba.
- 'forfeit' - Akaba jogu imediatamente i blokea pontuasion atuali
- Nomi di pilha: W (lixo), F1-F4 (fundasaun), T1-T7 (tableau)

Bo podi esekuta aksion multiple den un turnu separando ku vigula:
  Exemplu: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Só Rei podi saí koloká na pilha di tableau vaziu.
Aksion esekuta den ordem - si unu falha, aksion restante ta skipa.
Usa 'forfeit' si bo krei ku jogu e imposivel pa gana.
